name: 1122-written-over
about: A mod that writes outside a block of its memory (one byte in front, one past the end) is turned off when the kernel finds it: at the block's free, or at the mod's take-out for a block it kept. Said once a mod (MEMORY, the mod log's Memory.WrittenBefore or Memory.WrittenAfter); every block is freed whole and the game goes on (M-003; before, a write in front stopped the game)

expect.log: \[mod lt-memfront\] MEMORY: it wrote in front of a block of its memory\. It is off until the next start; what it was changing may be half done\.
\[mod lt-memback\] MEMORY: it wrote past the end of a block of its memory\. It is off until the next start; what it was changing may be half done\.
\[mod lt-memkeep\] MEMORY: it wrote in front of a block of its memory\. It is off until the next start; what it was changing may be half done\.

expect.no_log: was written over in front of its bytes|memory count is wrong
